Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the neuropeptide S receptor (CHEMBL5162) in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary, filtering by target chembl_id CHEMBL5162 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
